apply.intro: We ask only what this lease needs, one question at a time.

question.why.q_customer_type: A person and a business answer different questions: for you, your age and income; for a business, its ID and who can sign the contract.
question.why.q_full_name: The contract is made in your name.
question.why.q_birth_date: You must be 18 or older to sign a lease.
question.why.q_email: Invoices and the contract are sent here.
question.why.q_country: We can lease only to residents of Finland, Sweden and Estonia.
question.why.q_employment: Helps us check the rent fits your budget.
question.why.q_monthly_income: Rent may be at most 30 % of net income for consumers.
question.why.q_business_id: Identifies the business that signs the contract.
question.why.q_company_name: Printed on the contract and invoices.
question.why.q_can_sign: Only an authorised signatory can make the contract binding.
question.why.q_signatory_email: We send the contract to them for signing.
question.why.q_vat_registered: Changes how we show prices: with or without VAT.
question.why.q_usage_purpose: Delivery riding puts far more kilometres on a bike than commuting. We check the kilometres and the condition when the bike comes back.
question.why.q_farm_registry: Farm machines are leased to registered farms or contractors.
question.why.q_annual_revenue: Required for leases of 50,000 EUR or more.
question.why.q_beneficial_owners: Anti-money-laundering law requires us to know who owns the business.
question.why.q_pep: Required by anti-money-laundering law for leases of 10,000 EUR or more.
question.why.q_pep_details: A politically exposed person needs a manual check by a person, not a rule.

passport.cardText: Every life this item has had, and the CO₂ and money its later lives saved.
passport.title: Passport
passport.intro: {make} {model}: every lease this item has had, and the CO₂ and money its later lives saved.
passport.pastLife: Before our records: the dates are not known, {months} months assumed
passport.noLives: No leases yet: this item is waiting for its first life.
passport.co2FirstLife: First life: no saving, the item was made for it
passport.co2Total: CO₂e saved by its later lives
passport.co2AtLeaseEnd: {kg} kg at the end of the current lease ({date})
passport.moneyTotal: Money saved by its later lives
passport.moneyAtLeaseEnd: {amount} at the end of the current lease ({date})
passport.moneyEstimated: Estimated: lives before our records count only the refurbishment costs we know were paid.
passport.method.1: Making a new one: {footprint} kg CO₂.
passport.method.2: Refurbishing costs {share} % of that; the rest is saved.
passport.method.3: The saving is spread over a {designLife}-month design life and counted for each month leased.
passport.method.4: The first life saves nothing. Once the design life is used up, a further life saves nothing more.
passport.moneyMethod.1: Today’s list price of a new item, for the months each later life used of the {designLife}-month design life.
passport.moneyMethod.2: Minus what getting the item ready cost, from the refurbishment cost table.
passport.moneyMethod.3: The first life saves nothing, and neither does a life after the design life is used up.
passport.moneyMethod.4: Lives before our records: we count only the steps every relisting needs ({mandatory}), so the amount is an estimate.
impact.title: Why it's greener
impact.intro: Every item we lease again stands in for a new one that would otherwise be made. So far, the second and third lives of items leased through Lease Loop have saved:
impact.moneyEstimated: Estimated for lives before our records: we count only the refurbishment costs we know were paid.
impact.byCategory.e_bike: {kg} kg CO₂e and {amount} saved by e-bike leasing
impact.byCategory.laptop: {kg} kg CO₂e and {amount} saved by laptop leasing
impact.byCategory.farm_machine: {kg} kg CO₂e and {amount} saved by farm machine leasing
impact.how.label: How is this calculated?
impact.how.points.1: Leasing an item again means one new item doesn’t have to be made.
impact.how.points.2: Each later life saves the CO₂ of making a new one, minus {share} % for refurbishing.
impact.how.points.3: That saving is spread over the item’s design life and counted for the months the life lasted.
impact.how.points.4: The first life saves nothing, and neither does a worn-out item.
impact.how.money.1: Today’s list price of a new item, for the months each later life used.
impact.how.money.2: Minus what refurbishing the item actually cost.
impact.how.passport: Each item’s passport shows its own numbers.

audit.chain.reason.prev_hash_mismatch: it does not point to the entry before it
audit.chain.reason.hash_mismatch: its content changed after it was written
audit.chain.headLabel: Head hash, copy it to anchor the log
audit.chain.explain: Each entry carries the hash of the entry before it and a signature made with a key kept outside the database, and every new head is copied to an anchor file outside it. An edit, deletion or rewrite made outside the app shows here. Tamper-evident, not tamper-proof.

secondLife.decision.title: The decision
